0022600137.text: The New York Knicks (1-3), 12th in the East and two games back in the Atlantic, visit the Chicago Bulls (1-3), 11th in the East and two games back in the Central, in the Knicks' fifth game of the season. New York is 0-1 on the road and is coming off a win, while Chicago is 0-1 at home and has lost its last two; Jose Alvarado is out for the Knicks with an ankle sprain, and the Bulls are without Nic Claxton (hamstring), with Patrick Williams (groin soreness) and Tobe Awaka (ankle) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Knicks won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 136-96 win in New York on April 3, 2026.
